name: cevent-hosting-method
description: Event hosting plan prds/events/event-hosting-plan.md § 5 (rulings EH1–EH11, Doug 11-14/15-26): CEvent.hostedBy becomes the hosting method. Two options added, Zoom Meetings and Other platform; the stored value CBM Zoom is kept, so no event record changes, and is shown as Zoom Webinars. Nothing is removed. The Zoom identifiers serve both Zoom methods: CEvent.zoomWebinarId holds a meeting's id as it does a webinar's, and CEventRegistration's join link and registrant id serve both (the probe of 11-15-26 found the same shapes). Handoff: cevent-hosting-method-crm-handoff.md. OPEN-ITEMS #84, after #80.

enumOptions.tooltipText: How an online event is hosted. Zoom Webinars and Zoom Meetings: the application creates the event in the chapter's Zoom account, takes the registrations and sends each person their own join link. Other platform: staff type one join link for everyone; the application still takes the registrations and sends the confirmation. Outside host: a partner runs it on their own platform; type the host's link, and the Register button sends visitors there. Attendance is read from Zoom for the two Zoom methods only.
